PEMBROKESHIRE, WALES: What happens when a house becomes the setting for a haunting that stretches across decades? The Paranormal Chronicles invites listeners into a chilling Welsh paranormal account in its compelling episode, “Inside A Most Terrifying True Welsh Haunting!”

Hosted by bestselling author and paranormal researcher G.L. Davies, author of A Most Haunted House, Haunted: Horror of Haverfordwest and Harvest: The True Story of Alien Abduction, this atmospheric episode explores the beginnings of a reported haunting in Haverfordwest, West Wales.

Described in the episode’s introduction as one of the most prolific modern hauntings, the case would span more than 30 years. This instalment takes listeners back to its early days, opening the door to an unsettling story that continues to provoke curiosity, debate and fascination.

LISTEN TO THE FULL EPISODE HERE > https://open.spotify.com/episode/0xPykZChGoMFIWayQXPjXC

For anyone drawn to Welsh ghost stories, haunted houses and unexplained experiences, this is an invitation to discover the origins of a disturbing account. What began within a home would become the subject of A Most Haunted House, bringing this Pembrokeshire haunting to a wider audience.

Davies brings his experience as a bestselling paranormal author to a subject closely connected with his writing, inviting audiences to consider the story and reach their own conclusions.

Whether you approach paranormal accounts as a believer, a sceptic or an intrigued newcomer, this 42-minute episode offers a compelling reason to put on your headphones and explore the stranger side of Wales.

Follow The Paranormal Chronicles for more ghost stories, paranormal interviews, UFO encounters and explorations of the unexplained. Share this episode with a fellow mystery enthusiast, leave a rating, and join G.L. Davies as he opens another door into the unknown.
